title: Sources, assumptions and calculation trail
scope: External contextual sources were checked for the new MIPP assessment and portfolio method disclosure. Existing individual prices and their dates are retained; this is not a new independent valuation of all projects.

sources.title: Intellectual Property Valuation Basics — The cost method
sources.finding: Cost-based reproduction/replacement is a starting point; cost and negotiated value may differ.
sources.application: Method selection and the cost-versus-value boundary; no asset amount or discount is supplied by WIPO.

sources.title: Software developer freelance rates in 2026
sources.finding: Reported 2026 mean software-developer rate: EUR 94/hour excluding VAT; broader survey includes over 20,000 Dutch self-employed people.
sources.application: External Dutch rate cross-check. The retained EUR 100–137.50/hour role assumptions reflect an analyst-selected specialist budget and exceed this mean; the mean is not claimed to validate them.

sources.title: Software developer hiring costs
sources.finding: Global headline range USD 10–100/hour; the detailed expert tier is USD 70–150+/hour.
sources.application: Broad expertise/location sensitivity only. Global marketplace contract ranges are not a Dutch quote or an IP-sale comparable.

internalEvidence.access: Private source available through controlled review; no source code or author content is published here.

assumptions: Engineering-equivalent effort is not recorded development time or actual expenditure.
The retained role budgets are analyst choices; Knab and Upwork provide context and do not endorse them.
The 15% coordination/tooling allowance is not added as a second hourly-rate overhead; it budgets separate project-level coordination and tooling work.
The 30% seller asking factor is a negotiation choice, not a market-observed IP discount.
Market, income and strategic proxies share the same cost anchor; they are correlated model scenarios, not three independent valuations.
No paid-user base, attributable recurring income, completed comparable sale or independent certified appraisal is evidenced for MIPP.

newAssetBudget.scope: Existing first-party v0.1.0 local manuscript authoring, DOCX assembly, evidence-linked eight-gate/40-stage quality workflow, defect and change controls, explicit author release authorization, read-only dashboard, manual Draft2Digital handoff, tests and documentation at the frozen repository baseline. The embedded author-supplied protocol must have separately agreed use/transfer rights. Author manuscripts, creative archive ownership, author identity/pen-name rights, third-party services and templates, separately staged v0.2–v0.5 application code, automated literary/factual certification, autonomous book generation, live distribution and future SaaS are outside this price.

workPackages.scope: Immutable protocol and sequential evidence gates
Chapter input, manuscript inspection and DOCX assembly
Local dashboard, CLI and manual handoff
Regression fixtures, provenance and handover documentation

newAssetBudget.boundary: Work effort, retained role rates, 15% allowance, rounding and 30% asking factor are seller-side analyst assumptions; they are not recorded hours, expenditure, contractor quotations, market transactions or an independent appraisal.

calculation.sensitivityBasis: Low: 420 assumed hours at EUR 85/hour +15%; high: 700 hours at EUR 137.50/hour +15%. These effort/rate bounds are analyst scenarios, not a statistical confidence interval. Flat-rate comparison: 560 hours at the published Knab EUR 94 mean +15%.

methodBoundary: These external sources support method/rate context. The project amount follows the disclosed source scope and analyst effort/price assumptions. It is a seller asking reference, not established market value.
